title: Extract production deployment targets
task: Read rollout.json. Create targets.tsv with the service name and port for each enabled production target, sorted by service name. Create unique-ports.txt with their unique ports in numeric order. Skip disabled targets and other environments.
hints: Inspect all records with jq . and identify the environment and enabled fields.
Combine the conditions with and. Use jq -r and @tsv to get one name and port row per matching object.
Extract field 2 from the TSV and use sort -nu. Notice that lexical sorting would put 10100 before 443.

checks.label: Only enabled production targets appear in a sorted TSV
checks.feedback: Check both filter conditions and put exactly one tab between name and port.

checks.label: Ports are unique and numerically sorted
checks.feedback: Extract just the port column and sort numerically with duplicates removed.

demo.explanation: The JSON pipeline selects objects and @tsv prints their fields with a literal tab.
cut defaults to tab separation. Numeric sort treats ports as numbers and removes duplicates.
